cut: Global 2, VIRAL CUT v2 (23 Oct) of Ends in 3. Owner on v1: 'needs clarity of messaging'. Four beats: what (the 3s die), why (not linked to an ID), how (by last digit), the alert. Hook-first, and the last frame hands back to the first (plan/films/23b-ends-in-3-viral.md).
argument: Mexico cut off 2.2 million phone lines not linked to an ID (a rule against extortion and fraud), by last digit, 5s due 31 October; cut-off phones still get the quake alert.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: Mexico: every / phone must be / linked to an [ID].
text.fi: Meksiko: jokainen liittymä / on liitettävä omistajan / [henkilötunnukseen].
text.ja: メキシコ: すべての 電話は / 持ち主の [IDに] / 登録が 必要。

captions.source: Mexico's telecom regulator, the CRT: since 9 Jan 2026 every mobile line must be linked to its holder's name and CURP (the national ID number) through the phone company, with an official ID; lines not linked by their deadline are suspended (El Financiero, Expansión, CRT statements as carried by El Imparcial and Chilango; search summaries, 23–24 Oct). v3 (owner, 24 Oct: 'You have to have ID linked or it doesn't work?') leads with the rule itself.

text.en: No ID linked? / [Cut off.] / 2.2 million / in one round.
text.fi: Ei tunnusta liitetty? / [Katkaistu.] / 2,2 miljoonaa yhdellä kierroksella.
text.ja: IDが 未登録なら / [停止]。 / 1回で 220万回線。

captions.source: CRT figures via El Financiero, 5 Oct 2026: 2,248,143 lines ending in 3 suspended after their deadline (30 Sep, grace to 3 Oct), as of 4 Oct; about 1.21 million reactivated by then. 'One round' = the batch of lines ending in 3 (the next caption explains the rounds go by last digit). NOT used: a cumulative '3.5 million'. The ending-4 figure of ~1.3 million in the earlier notes could not be confirmed as suspensions on 24 Oct: search summaries give it as the CRT's projection of further REACTIVATIONS for the 4s (CRT, 18 Oct: 9,928,170 lines ending in 4 linked, 88.2 % of 11.2 million; 1,021,939 reactivated). The 2.2 million is therefore one round only, and the caption says so.

text.en: Each number has / its own deadline, / set by its [last digit].
text.fi: Jokaisella numerolla / on oma määräaikansa: / sen [viimeinen numero].
text.ja: 番号ごとに 期限が 違う。 / 決めるのは / [末尾の 数字]。

captions.source: The CRT's calendar by the line's last digit: 0 due 15 Aug through 9 due 31 Dec 2026 (one deadline per final digit). The CRT's calendar by the line's last digit (0 on 15 Aug to 9 on 31 Dec). Lines ending in 3: due 30 Sep (grace to 3 Oct), 2,248,143 suspended as of 4 Oct (El Financiero, 5 Oct). Ending in 4: due 15 Oct, suspended within 72 hours, 1,328,000 by 19 Oct (Informador). Ending in 5: due 31 Oct, not moved as of 23 Oct (Excélsior, Xataka, N+, UnoTV; search summaries, 23 Oct). The 0s to 2s went before; the calendar shows them crossed. Re-checked 24 Oct (search summaries: El CEO, Fox Sports MX, N+): ending in 5 still due 31 Oct 2026; suspension follows 72 hours after a deadline.

text.en: Number ends in 5? / Link it by / [31 Oct].
text.ja: 末尾が 5なら / 期限は / [10月31日]。

captions.source: Lines ending in 5: due 31 Oct 2026, re-checked 24 Oct (Infobae, El Imparcial 17 Oct, N+; search summaries); suspension within 72 h after the deadline. 0–4 have passed and those unlinked were suspended. The CRT's calendar by the line's last digit (0 on 15 Aug to 9 on 31 Dec). Lines ending in 3: due 30 Sep (grace to 3 Oct), 2,248,143 suspended as of 4 Oct (El Financiero, 5 Oct). Ending in 4: due 15 Oct, suspended within 72 hours, 1,328,000 by 19 Oct (Informador). Ending in 5: due 31 Oct, not moved as of 23 Oct (Excélsior, Xataka, N+, UnoTV; search summaries, 23 Oct). The 0s to 2s went before; the calendar shows them crossed. Re-checked 24 Oct (search summaries: El CEO, Fox Sports MX, N+): ending in 5 still due 31 Oct 2026; suspension follows 72 hours after a deadline.

text.en: No calls, no texts. / But quake alerts / still [get through].
text.fi: Ei puheluita, ei viestejä. / Mutta maanjäristysvaroitus / [menee silti läpi].
text.ja: 通話も SMSも 不可。 / でも 地震警報は / [届く]。

captions.source: CRT, as carried by El Universal, Milenio, Xataka, ADN40 and El Imparcial (search summaries, 23 Oct): a suspended line cannot make or receive ordinary calls, send texts or use data, yet still receives the seismic alert and can still call 911; it is not cancelled, and service returns once the line is linked. The station's line over its own image; not a quote. v3 keeps 'But … still', not 'Only quake alerts': a suspended line can also still call 911, so 'only' would be false.

digits.why: each phone shows the last digit of its line; numbers, the same in every master

calendar.why: the calendar of deadlines by last digit (CRT); digits and day/month dates, the same in every master

id.why: the card's band and the name of Mexico's national ID number; the photo is a mask, no face, no name

alert.en: a triangle with a seismograph trace
alert.why: the alert screen is an icon only, so no master says the wrong words; it shows an alert, never a quake

number.why: a phone number with its middle masked (no real number), its last digit boxed; digits only, the same in every master

post.en: Mexico requires every phone line to be linked to its owner's ID, against extortion and fraud. Each number's deadline is set by its last digit. 2.2 million ending in 3 were cut in one round; numbers ending in 5 are due 31 Oct. Quake alerts still get through. What does yours end in?
post.es: México exige vincular cada línea a la CURP de su titular, contra la extorsión y el fraude. El plazo depende del último dígito del número. Con terminación 3 se suspendieron 2,2 millones en una ronda; el 5 vence el 31 de octubre. La alerta sísmica sí llega. ¿En qué termina la tuya?
post.fi: Meksikossa jokainen liittymä on liitettävä omistajan henkilötunnukseen, kiristystä ja petoksia vastaan. Kunkin numeron määräaika riippuu sen viimeisestä numerosta. 3:een päättyviä katkaistiin 2,2 miljoonaa; 5:een päättyvien määräaika on 31.10. Maanjäristysvaroitus menee silti läpi. Mihin omasi päättyy?
post.ja: メキシコでは、すべての携帯回線を持ち主のIDに登録する義務がある。恐喝と詐欺対策だ。期限は番号の末尾の数字で決まる。末尾3は1回で220万回線が停止。末尾5の期限は10月31日。停止中でも地震警報は届く。あなたの番号の末尾は？
